Wk.bar_b_note: Cannonback and Ripplet still stack into one mass in t-024 and touch in t-023/t-025 on a flat, evenly lit pale beach with no haze, rim light or time-of-day grade, so it sits well below Palworld's staged, atmospheric combat.

Yh.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, stone footing and plank cap read as built, but it is still one free-standing panel with pale infill, and B is a blown-out white card; neither looks like Palworld's chunky placed base pieces.

Np.bar_b_note: The creatures read well against the sky, but the capture-chance text is dark, unbacked and lost against pale sand and the creatures, and the empty sand slope with scattered black pebbles lacks Palworld's density and depth.

Hd.bar_b_note: The ram's fleece, horns and blue gem match the owner style bar and tower over the ruler; A is held back by a faint-mid pose floating high above its shadow and a faint-end that rolls onto its back with a grey underside, and B by a nose-down, rump-up faint end.

Rb.bar_b_note: The roster now sits on a dark backing panel that holds over sand and water, but the rows are tiny, and the flat, hazeless beach with crowded creatures does not match Palworld finish.

Vz.bar_b_note: The workbench is a small, unreadable prop behind the trainer in first_shore and brine_steps and a tiny table by the tent in salt_crown, in a sparse camp of a tent and campfire on bare sand, far from Palworld's legible base stations.

Qi.bar_b_note: The boss card now sits top-right clear of Cannonback, but the Nerissa frame is dominated by a giant translucent blue crystal slab that hides half the arena, and the beach frames stay flat and evenly lit.

Pd.bar_b_note: A's large wrapped recipe lines and white Craft and Leave labels read at both resolutions, though only three recipes fit and the key glyphs are tiny; B truncates recipes ('3 St...') in small text and hides 'Craft: A / Enter' and 'Leave: B / Esc' as dim fine print, short of Palworld's bold HUD hierarchy.

Op.bar_b_note: The bed is still a flat sand-filled oval curb in first_shore that turns into a thin pale ring beside the tent in salt_crown and has no bedding, straw or raised nest form, and a brown furry creature blocks the left of first_shore.

Zn.bar_b_note: The shinies now keep species form with mint, slate and teal-violet finishes instead of magenta, but they stand small and pale against bright sand and water with no rim light or shiny sparkle cue.

Lk.bar_b_note: Adair is clear, but the player's head still crowds and touches Iona and Rowan, the dialogue box hides the speakers' lower bodies, and in the Iona frame a flat dark cliff slab fills the right third.

Fc.bar_b_note: Ripplet and Aquaryn lie flat and read as down, but Riptusk still sits in an upright crouch with its head raised, and all three are small, low-contrast shapes on the shoreline far from the camera.

Ge.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder has a clear face, readable eyes, an olive and brown villager palette and a clean full-body silhouette; only his softer animated-film face style sits slightly apart from the naturalistic creature bar.

top_changes.change: Re-grade and dress the Tidewake beach: a warm low sun with rim light on creatures, distance haze over the water, a wet-sand band at the waterline, and grouped dune grass, driftwood and rock clusters instead of bare flat sand with even pebble scatter.

Add staging and camera spacing rules for fights and dialogue: minimum separation between allies, enemies and the trainer, and a dialogue camera offset that frames the speaker clear of the player's head, so subjects stop stacking (Wk, Rb, Lk).
Model hero camp props: a workbench with vise, tools and a worked top that reads at gameplay distance, and a raised creature nest bed with straw or bedding mounds (Vz, Op).
